message.text:
Cybersecurity is a great fit — MDC has a clear, stackable path that works even on a tight budget and part-time schedule.

**Your path**
- **Fastest:** Cybersecurity Analyst (College Credit Certificate) — 24 credits, ~12–18 months part-time. Enter the job market quickly.
- **Associate:** Cybersecurity (A.S.) — 60 credits, ~45 months part-time. Stronger credentials, higher earning potential.
- **Bachelor's:** Cybersecurity (B.S.) — 120 credits, stay entirely at MDC, no transfer needed.

> All cost figures are **estimates** — MDC data doesn't include per-credit tuition rates. Contact MDC for exact numbers.

**Money**
- **Pell Grant:** up to ~$7,395/year if you qualify (need-based, no repayment).
- **FSAG & Bright Futures:** Florida state grants — eligibility depends on residency, GPA, and enrollment.
- **Federal Work-Study:** part-time campus jobs that work around your schedule.
- Grants and scholarships never need to be repaid; loans do.

**Next step**
File your **FAFSA today** at [studentaid.gov](https://studentaid.gov) and list Miami Dade College — then book a free session with an MDC advisor to map your schedule around your job.
